item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence on budgets, inflation targeting, digitized administration, and campaign rhetoric.\nI did not find much direct independent evidence showing Modi personally admitted economic mistakes and then reversed them on that basis. The best “correction” evidence is indirect: tighter post-election budgeting, continued inflation targeting, and revised spending priorities after the vote.\nSeveral positive items are official self-reports or budget documents, so they show intent and implementation claims more than independent outcome verification.","evidence":[{"title":"India plans to spend $134 billion on infrastructure, narrow fiscal gap - interim budget","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-02-01","url":"https://theprint.in/india/india-plans-to-spend-134-billion-on-infrastructure-narrow-fiscal-gap-interim-budget/1948810/","summary":"The interim budget raised infrastructure spending to a record level, increased education and health outlays, and kept the fiscal deficit on a tightening path. That supports an evidence-based, not merely slogan-driven, policy stance.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.4","5B.6"]},{"title":"India refrains from populist budget before election, trims fiscal deficit","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-02-01","url":"https://theprint.in/economy/india-refrains-from-populist-budget-before-election-trims-fiscal-deficit/1948823/","summary":"Reuters described the budget as resisting big election giveaways and sticking to fiscal consolidation to attract investors. That is good evidence for policy discipline rather than pure patronage.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.1","5B.4","5B.6"]},{"title":"Governor’s Statement: August 8, 2024","publisher":"Reserve Bank of India","date":"2024-08-08","url":"https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=58448","summary":"The RBI said the inflation framework had worked, inflation was on a declining trajectory, and it kept rates unchanged after a detailed assessment of macro conditions. That is strong evidence of evidence-based macro management.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.3","5B.4","5B.6"]},{"title":"With renewed focus on next generation administrative reforms the Government has approved an outlay of Rs. 235.10 crore","publisher":"Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions","date":"2024-01-18","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=1997326&lang=2&reg=48","summary":"The government approved AI-assisted grievance redress, service delivery improvements, process re-engineering, and capacity-building for administrative reforms. This is direct evidence of technocratic correction and administrative modernization.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"Digital Agriculture Mission: Tech for Transforming Farmers’ Lives","publisher":"Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare","date":"2024-09-04","url":"https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2051719&lang=2&reg=3","summary":"The Digital Agriculture Mission was framed around geospatial data, crop surveys, soil maps, and farmer registries to improve agricultural decisions. That supports a reading of state capacity built around measurable systems and data infrastructure.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.6"]},{"title":"India budget shifts spending priorities while keeping fiscal deficit in check","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-07-23","url":"https://theprint.in/india/india-budget-shifts-spending-priorities-while-keeping-fiscal-deficit-in-check/2187377/","summary":"The post-election budget kept the deficit under control while redirecting spending toward jobs, rural programs, and investment-linked measures. This is positive evidence for policy adjustment informed by growth constraints, though still largely prospective.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.4","5B.6"]},{"title":"India’s Modi prevails over allies in cabinet line-up","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-06-11","url":"https://theprint.in/india/indias-modi-prevails-over-allies-in-cabinet-line-up/2126130/","summary":"Modi kept senior economic portfolios in the same hands after the election setback. That is a modest sign of continuity and technocratic stability, though not proof of willingness to correct mistakes.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.2","5B.4"]}]}
